svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Setpoint slider (obc-slider, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Controls. Box 288x48 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value (default 50, rw): Setpoint, written while dragging (debounced) _pn_min (default 0, read): Minimum _pn_max (default 100, read): Maximum _pn_step (default 1, read): Step _pn_stepClick (default 10, read): Step of the -/+ buttons (enhanced variant) _ps_variant (default 'normal', read): Style: normal | enhanced (with -/+ buttons) | no-input (read only) _pb_disabled (default false, read): Disabled (operator cannot act)
